Lot 69
Industrial Development
Unit 6A-6B South Middleton Base
Greenwell Road, Aberdeen, AB12 3AX
Please refer to auctioneer for more information
 
All
A Vacant Substantial Detached Industrial Building. Potential for Development (Subject to Obtaining all Relevant Consents)

Description

The property comprises a detached industrial building arranged to provide offices and warehouses over ground and first floors.

Tenure

Leasehold. The property is held on a 128 year lease from 28th May 2008 (thus approximately 110 years unexpired) at a passing ground rent of £39,500 per annum.

Location

The property is situated on a mixed use road close to local shops and amenities. The open spaces of Tullos Wood are within easy reach. Transport links are provided by Aberdeen rail station.

Accommodation

Ground and First Floors
Reception Room
Two Offices
Two Warehouses

G.I.A Approximately 3,205 sq m (34,496 sq ft)

Exterior

The property benefits from secure yard area and parking.

Tenancy

The property was previously let for £280,000 per annum

VAT

VAT is applicable
